en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Central European town on a wooded hill. At the top of the hill stands a large church with a tall spire and several substantial historic buildings, likely part of a castle complex. Below, dense trees cover the slope, with a winding path and retaining wall in the foreground and smaller houses and factory buildings with a chimney in the lower town. The scene is framed by a white border, and cursive writing appears at the bottom left.
